title: CA-413 STILL OPEN: srd_root relativization is purely lexical, so a symlinked repo path never matches git rev-parse --show-toplevel's physical path; the hook takes its non-blocking exit-1 arm and commit-time artifact lint silently stops enforcing for that developer

CA-414 STILL OPEN: echo "$staged" plus git's default core.quotePath is interpreter-dependent -- on an ash host one staged path becomes two lines, the allowlist drops it, and the hook exits 0 without linting

NEW: lint:hooks-shell is a blocking job whose shellcheck --include set covers SC2086, and hooks.json:86 contains both 'for p in $prefixes' and 'exit $fail' -- likely red on first run with no escape valve since a directive cannot be added inside a single-line JSON string command
NEW: lint:hooks-shell newline-splits extracted hook commands, so a multi-line .command is syntax-checked as N independent fragments and COUNT over-reports with no cross-check

NEW: check_permission_rules resolves settings.json against process cwd rather than the project/repo root, producing false prose-only negatives from a subdirectory and false permission-ask positives from an unrelated directory
NEW: the temp-file trap covers EXIT INT TERM but omits HUP, diverging from every other trap layer in the plugin; runs on every git commit so a SIGHUP leaks two files per commit

NEW (residue of CA-415): the corrected fd-200 rationale has no durability pin anywhere in bin/tests/, unlike the neighbouring CA-169 invariant, so the comment can be shortened back to the buggy wording with nothing failing
NEW: eval:nightly, the one job holding ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, uploads evals/runs/ with when:always and expire_in:30 days including raw stderr logs, with no exclude or redaction

CA-233 VERIFIED FIXED: lint:bash-syntax, lint:shellcheck and the in-suite T61 AC10 twin all carry the identical *.awk|*.txt exclusion, with a cross-loop consistency assertion that can no longer self-match
CA-349 VERIFIED FIXED: the npm pin needle now requires a numeric character after the version @, with both a bare-unpinned and an @latest negative control
CA-415 VERIFIED FIXED: the fd-200 rationale now states the real constraint (0-2, fd 9 BASH_XTRACEFD, the 10+ redirection-bookkeeping band); the durability pin is filed separately as open
CA-381 remains NOTED per its recorded disposition; cross-lens pointer only -- the disposition's own 'deferred' language conflicts with the severity vocabulary's abolition of deferral
Placeholder image digests and floating bash:3.2 tag remain a known, documented gap (CA-111)
The deferred status token is NOT a convergence bypass: BLOCKING_FILTER includes it and coerce_status rewrites it to open before any count
Bare Bash on auto-spawned/implementer/test-writer agents carries a documented compensating rationale (D17 spike) and is cross-checked by edm-check-grants
The only eval() in production code operates on bash's own trap -p output with no external data reaching it
update-patterns' read-only-install hazard is already guarded by a [[ -w $pattern_dir ]] skip returning 0
Fresh full-scope fd sweep: flock's 200> is the only numeric fd anywhere in bin/, evals/ or hooks/; clean
Temp-file hygiene sweep: every production mktemp uses the house XXXXXX template under TMPDIR except three portable bare calls; no predictable-path plant target
acceptEdits plus prefix Bash matchers is accurately documented as a bounded, non-airtight tradeoff for an unattended run; bypassPermissions deliberately unused
The eval phase prompt is visible in the process table via claude -p argv, but content is frozen fixture text -- no exposure today, flagged for future adopters
Two hardcoded developer-machine paths sit in a licence-provenance record documenting a local clone inspection; naming the machine is the point, not executable
The unquoted for-loop word-split, ENVIRON-passing awk, and per-command EDM_SRD_ROOT prefix are all intentional and correct
Systemd sandboxing category not applicable: no unit files, no images, no init-managed daemon; equivalent confinement surface audited as L8-003/L8-004/L8-N04
SQL injection, SSRF and cryptographic-failure categories not applicable: no database, no caller-supplied-URL HTTP client, no stored secret; artifact_hash is integrity tooling not a crypto control
